sn46.50:1.1: Bāhiram bhikkhave aṅgan ti kāritvā nāññam ekaṅgam pi samanupassāmi || sattannam bojjhaṅgānam uppādāya || yathayidam bhikkhave kalyāṇamittatā || || 3.
sn46.50:1.2: Kalyāṇamittassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ satta bojjhaṅge bhāvessati- bahulīkarissati || ||
sn46.50:1.3: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti -bahulīkaroti || || 4.
sn46.50:1.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || la [-pe] ||
sn46.50:1.5: upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggaparināmiṃ || || 5.
sn46.50:1.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto sattabojjhaṅge bhāveti- bahulīkarotī ti || ||
sn46.50:2.4: Ādicco Aṅgena te dasā ti || || Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || 2. Pañcannaṃ ca
